nodes.summary: Fine structure of real functions: Blumberg's theorem, continuous nowhere-differentiable functions (Weierstrass, Takagi), the rising sun lemma, approximate continuity, midpoint convexity, and the Cauchy, exponential and almost-additive functional equations including Hyers–Ulam stability.
nodes.title: Continuity, regularity and functional equations

nodes.summary: Derivatives of real functions of one real variable: mean-value and second-derivative tests, Taylor polynomials and remainders, Borel's lemma, interchange of limits and derivatives, monotone and C^n gluing results; not nowhere-differentiable constructions (see continuity subfield).
nodes.title: Differential calculus of one variable

nodes.summary: The Riemann integral via tagged partitions, iterated-integral formulas, moments, and closed-form evaluations of specific definite integrals (Serret's integral, integrals of 1/(1+u^n), areas between cosine powers, sinc squared); integrals defining a named special function go to Special functions.
nodes.title: Riemann integration and definite integrals

nodes.summary: Functions on R^n: partial derivatives, gradients, Jacobians, Hessians, implicit functions, regular level sets and tangent spaces, curve length, Green's theorem, multivariable Taylor expansions and counterexamples about mixed partials or continuity at the origin.
nodes.title: Multivariable calculus

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
